test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a part of the growth area under the Digital India programme?
solution:
The correct answer is **Public school education for all**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Digital India** is a flagship program launched by the Government of India to transform the country into a digitally empowered society and knowledge economy.
 
• The primary focus areas of the Digital India programme include **universal access to mobile services**, **e-governance**, and **broadband highways**.
 
• **Public school education for all** is not specifically mentioned as a growth area under the Digital India programme.
 
• The initiative aims to ensure that government services are made available to citizens electronically by improving online infrastructure and increasing internet connectivity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Component
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Broadband Highways
 **Provide high-speed internet** access to all citizens, especially in rural areas.
 
 

 Universal Access to Mobile Connectivity
 Ensure **mobile connectivity** in all uncovered areas in the country.
 
 

 Public Internet Access Programme
 **Establish Common Service Centres** in rural and remote areas to provide digital services.
 
 

 E-Governance
 Transform and simplify the **delivery of government services** through digital means.
 
 

 Information for All
 Facilitate open access to **government data and information** for citizens.
